name: Admin-dashboard
description: This GitHub repository contains a dynamic and interactive dashboard built using Python's Streamlit library and Plotly visualization tools. The project aims to provide an intuitive and visually appealing way to explore and analyze data effortlessly.

paragraphs: Sales Analytics Dashboard for Retail (Streamlit, Pandas, Plotly) Empower data-driven decisions in your retail business with this interactive dashboard! Analyze sales data to understand trends, customer behavior, and product performance.
